annotation.title_clean: 关于印发《安全应急装备重点领域发展行动计划（2023－2025年）》的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice on Issuing the Action Plan for the Development of Key Areas of Safety and Emergency Equipment (2023-2025)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 工业和信息化部; 国家发展和改革委员会; 科学技术部; 财政部; 应急管理部
annotation.venue: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT)
annotation.summary_en: Chinese five-ministry action plan (2023–2025) promoting the safety and emergency equipment industry, including rescue robots, firefighting robots, drones and unmanned mining vehicles. It sets industry targets (over 1 trillion yuan), R&D priorities, promotion catalogues, standards-building, insurance compensation, tax and financing support, and talent training.
key_provisions_or_claims: Target: key-area industry scale above 1 trillion yuan by 2025, 10+ internationally competitive leading firms
Priority R&D on rescue robots, firefighting robots, emergency drones and unmanned mining equipment
Publish catalogues of advanced and recommended equipment and household emergency products
Build standards system and standardisation bodies for safety emergency equipment
Include eligible equipment in first-set insurance compensation, tax credits, procurement and fund support
